summary.text: Henry Helgerson is a Democratic member of the Kansas House of Representatives representing District 83 (Sedgwick County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the House since 2016.
Henry Helgerson is listed as the ranking minority member of the Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the same page, Henry Helgerson served in the House (1983–2000) and the Senate (2003–2004) before the current service in the House that began in 2016.
Henry Helgerson is listed as a member of the Transportation Committee, the Appropriations Committee and the Taxation Committee.
The Legislature lists Henry Helgerson's occupation as Businessman.
The page names Nicholi A. Flynn as Henry Helgerson's spouse.
